about_the_game:
Idle Reincarnator - Your destiny through infinite lives

Step into a mystical world where each life brings new power, purpose, and adventure. Starting as a beggar in Eldoria, the last city of humanity, master professions, train skills, and explore areas. Reincarnate, grow stronger, and uncover the secrets of your past in this endlessly rewarding journey.

Features

  • Jobs - Begin as a humble beggar and ascend through 47 unique jobs, each with its own challenges and hidden rewards.

  • Train - Train your skills across many trainings. Battle foes, overcome trials, and evolve into a true master.

  • Explorations - Venture through 12 zones, each with their own stories.

  • Story - Discover 175 story fragments, face mythical creatures, and uncover lost treasures.

  • Reincarnation - When one life ends, another begins. Rebirth with permanent boosts, progress faster, and push further than ever before.

  • Technologies - Unlock 80 technologies to improve Eldoria.

  • Regression, Magic, and Lifestlye - Unlocked 30 temporal skills to aid you, 20 spells, and 46 lifestyle choices to customize your journey.

  • Estimated playtime - 30-40+ hours of content with an ending.
